_note: THE HEADLINE, criterion A5. p = 1/3 is Avena-Thomann's p = 2/3 (their p is
P(right | particle)); alpha = 1/2 is their rho = 1/2, and the default
env_sweeps = 4 with swap_prob = 1/2 is their gamma = 1.
The question is gamma = 1/2 (diffusive) against gamma > 1/2
(superdiffusive), NOT the third decimal of D: D is an amplitude and every
estimator in the article targets the exponent. At alpha = 1/2 the walk has
zero speed by particle-hole symmetry (proved: Hilario-Kious-Teixeira,
arXiv:1906.03167), and that same paper's CLT covers only the densities
where the speed is non-zero -- so what this recipe measures is open.
The ladder and the budget are set from our own pilot, not from anyone
else's grid: their numbers are read only after ours exist.
